Morghal and  Stone Guard Orgath guard the entrance to Grymforge in Act One.
“
Your Twat-Soul chum owes us a load of coin. You want in? Pay the toll.
„
— Morghal

Involvement

Act One

Morghal and  Orgarth 'greet' the party when they arrive at Grymforge the first time. She demands money from them as a fee because  Nere has not paid the duergar of Clan Flameshade. The party can refuse to pay without consequence.

Morghal is loyal to Clan Flameshade. Should the party conspire with  Brithvar against Nere, she joins them against the drow and duergar cultists.
